# TheLis3k — Ksawery

> Full-stack developer who ships end to end — from product framing and architecture
> down to the last pixel. Language-agnostic by choice: picks the right stack for the
> problem instead of forcing the problem into a familiar stack.

## Snapshot

- **Role:** Full-stack developer, automation engineer, product-minded builder
- **Currently:** Part-time IT student at PJATK; developer at Talentech on the product **Weekli**
- **Operating principle:** Clean architecture, SOLID, and shipping real value are the
  baseline — not the goal. Kaizen: leave every system better than he found it.

## Why he's worth a conversation

He sits in the rare overlap between three roles most people only do one of:

**As an engineer** — Builds production systems solo, across the whole stack: React/Angular
frontends, Spring Boot and NestJS backends, PostgreSQL/MongoDB data layers, Docker, CI, and
the Bash/Playwright glue in between. Auth done right (JWT with rotating refresh tokens,
invitation-based onboarding), not auth done "good enough." Picks up new languages and
frameworks fast because he learns the underlying model, not just the syntax.

**As a tech lead** — Thinks in systems, not tickets. At Talentech he architects automation
for client migrations, eliminates entire categories of manual work, and drives integrations
others wrote off as "too complex to automate." Translates fuzzy business needs into concrete
technical designs, and translates technical trade-offs back into plain language stakeholders
can actually decide on. Writes code that the *next* developer can read.

**As a product manager** — Builds things because they should exist, then makes them usable.
Mobile-first, bilingual UX, real onboarding flows, design-agency finish on a one-person
budget. He doesn't just ask "can we build it?" — he asks "should we, and what's the smallest
version that delivers the value?" Product analytics and business-data instincts inform what
gets built, not just how.

## Skills

**Tech:** JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, React, Angular, Spring Boot, NestJS, SvelteKit,
PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Drizzle ORM, Docker, Linux, Bash, Playwright, Python, Automated Testing,
Git, Vite, Product Analytics, Business Data Collection, AI Agents / Skills / Rules.

**Product & lead:** Requirements gathering, scoping to an MVP, system integration design,
process automation, technical-to-business translation, mobile-first UX, bilingual (PL/EN)
product delivery.

**Soft:** Fast learner, clear communicator, analytical problem solver, strong teammate,
relentless about continuous improvement (Kaizen). Yes — also a professional rubber-duck.

## Selected projects

Each was designed, built, and shipped to production by one person.

- **Evenciki.pl** — Event-planning platform: create an event, share a link, collect attendee
  responses. Mobile-first, bilingual (PL/EN). Product thinking front to back.
  *Tech: SvelteKit 5, NestJS, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, TanStack Query, Tailwind, Bun.*
  → https://evenciki.pl

- **Restaurant Admin** — Full-stack restaurant system: public reservation/menu site plus a
  role-based admin panel, JWT auth with rotating refresh tokens, invitation-based onboarding.
  The kind of auth most teams cut corners on — done properly here.
  *Tech: React, TypeScript, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, TanStack Query, Zustand, Docker.*
  → https://github.com/TheLis3k/WizytowkaSandbox

- **How Much Is My Hot Wheels** — Spring Boot REST API that scrapes eBay, Etsy, OLX, Vinted,
  and the Hot Wheels Wiki in parallel to aggregate live die-cast valuations. Built because it
  should exist.
  *Tech: Java 21, Spring Boot, MongoDB, JSoup, Playwright, Docker.*
  → https://github.com/TheLis3k/how-much-is-my-hot-wheels

- **CreativeShape** — Marketing site for a Polish NFC-keychain company, including a
  drag-to-rotate 3D STL viewer and a full product catalogue. Design-agency finish, one dev.
  *Tech: React, TypeScript, Vite, CSS Custom Properties.*
  → https://creativeshape.pl

- **WizytówkaWeb** — This portfolio. The comet that flies through the DOM is a hand-built
  canvas animation system following a 1,500-point Catmull-Rom flight path — built because a
  plain portfolio felt insufficient.
  *Tech: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Canvas API.*
  → https://github.com/TheLis3k/WebFrontEndShowcase
